description: Sources: by default short excerpts (view=summary), 5 texts per page, with the address of the full text in fragments[].full. Either package or fragment is required (a StableId from law_search/law_rules). view=full returns exact parts of the text: textRange sets a range of Unicode characters, fragments[].next is the continuation with a contentHash. The hash refers to the WHOLE source, not to the excerpt or the part. textOffset/textLimit require fragment; a continuation requires contentHash. Lists are paged with offset/limit; the answer budget may shrink a page.

contentHash.description: the hash of the full text taken from the previous part

language.description: the language of the variant, as given on the source card

limit.description: how many texts: summary 5, full 1 (the budget may lower it)

package.description: the package key — every fragment of that instrument

status.description: the status of the variant, as given on the source card

textLimit.description: the maximum number of Unicode characters in a part of the text (also ≤8000 bytes of UTF-8)

name: law_sources
